meta.title: Alfred Hitchcock: The Master of Suspense

paragraphs.text: Sir Alfred Hitchcock was an English movie director and producer. Famously 26 to as 'The Master of Suspense,' Hitchcock is one of the most influential filmmakers in the history of 27 . He was an extraordinary director who entertained his audience with 28 and gripping suspense movies.

sentences.text: Sir Alfred Hitchcock was an English movie director and producer.

analysis.translationLiteral: 阿尔弗雷德·希区柯克爵士曾是一位英国电影导演和制片人。
analysis.translationNatural: 希区柯克爵士是英国人，干的是导演兼制片的活儿。
analysis.structMarkup: 【Sir Alfred Hitchcock】 _was_ ~an English movie director and producer~.

components.note: Sir 加全名作主语，谓语用单数 was；头衔与姓名整体指同一人

components.part: an English movie director and producer

phrases.meaning: 先生、长官（对男性的尊称）；（Sir）爵士、阁下（信函称呼 Dear Sir）
phrases.usage: 本句中作n.，可按「主系表（一般过去时）」定位它在句中的位置。
phrases.example: Sir Alfred Hitchcock was an English movie director and producer. 希区柯克爵士是英国人，干的是导演兼制片的活儿。

analysis.paragraphRole: 用具体的作品特色坐实上句的『最有影响力』，并把 28 空安在与 gripping 并列的形容词位置。

paragraphs.text: His fascination with crime began at an early age when he was 29 by his father who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct. Hence, his movies are 30 of the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim. He had a gift for creating stories that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal 31 with incredible plot twists in the storyline. The principal characters in his movies were often ordinary people 32 in unwanted and unavoidable situations.

sentences.text: His fascination with crime began at an early age when he was 29 by his father who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他对犯罪的着迷在很小的年纪就开始了，当时他因行为不端被他的父亲 29，那位父亲让他在一个监狱里待几分钟。
analysis.translationNatural: 他打小就迷犯罪题材：小时候犯了错，父亲罚他进牢房里待上几分钟。
analysis.structMarkup: 【His fascination with crime】 _began at an early age_ {when he was 29 by his father} {who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct}.
analysis.structureSummary: 主谓 + 时间状语 + 时间状语从句（when 引导，含被动语态与 who 定语从句）

components.note: 抽象名词短语作主语；with crime 限定是『对哪方面』的着迷
began 为不及物动词过去式，at an early age 点明起点之早

components.part: when he was 29 by his father
components.note: when 引导时间状语从句；was + 过去分词构成被动，29 空需过去分词且要与 by his father 的施动关系相配

components.part: who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct
components.note: who 修饰 his father；make sb do 用不带 to 的不定式，for his misconduct 交代受罚缘由

clauses: 状语从句「when he was 29 by his father」：when 引导时间状语从句；was + 过去分词构成被动，29 空需过去分词且要与 by his father 的施动关系相配
定语从句「who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct」：who 修饰 his father；make sb do 用不带 to 的不定式，for his misconduct 交代受罚缘由
关系词引导定语从句，修饰前面的先行词；从句内部用陈述语序。

phrases.meaning: 做、制造；使得、使成为；获得（make 的过去式/过去分词）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。
phrases.example: His fascination with crime began at an early age when he was 29 by his father who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct. 他打小就迷犯罪题材：小时候犯了错，父亲罚他进牢房里待上几分钟。

phrases.meaning: 花费（时间/金钱）、度过、消耗、用尽（spend ... on sth / doing）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：sb spends time/money on sth 或 (in) doing（人作主语）/ sth costs sb money（物作主语）/ it takes sb time to do（it 作形式主语）/ sb pays money for sth（介词 for）/ spend、cost、take、pay 主语与句型不同，不能互换。
phrases.example: His fascination with crime began at an early age when he was 29 by his father who made him spend a few minutes inside a prison for his misconduct. 他打小就迷犯罪题材：小时候犯了错，父亲罚他进牢房里待上几分钟。

phrases.meaning: 分钟（minute 的复数）；会议记录
phrases.usage: 注意区分：minutes（分钟/会议记录）/ minute（微小的，读 /maɪˈnjuːt/）。常见搭配：ten minutes / in a few minutes。
phrases.example: Ten minutes of exercise a week helps. 每周锻炼十分钟就有帮助。

pitfalls: 定语从句中关系词已充当成分，从句里不要再重复该代词。
注意区分：be made of（由…制成，看得出原料）/ be made from（由…制成，看不出原料）/ be made in（产地）/ be made to do（被迫做，被动须加 to）/ make sb do（主动使役不带 to）/ make（make-made-made）。
注意区分：sb spends time/money on sth 或 (in) doing（人作主语）/ sth costs sb money（物作主语）/ it takes sb time to do（it 作形式主语）/ sb pays money for sth（介词 for）/ spend、cost、take、pay 主语与句型不同，不能互换。
analysis.paragraphRole: 追到童年那次惩罚，替全篇『为何偏爱罪与罚』给出源头，也把 29 空设在被动谓语上。

sentences.text: Hence, his movies are 30 of the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim.

analysis.translationLiteral: 因此，他的电影是 30 于作恶者与受害者的有罪与无辜的。
analysis.translationNatural: 所以他的片子总绕着『谁有罪、谁清白』打转，把加害人和受害人一并摆上台面。
analysis.structMarkup: (Hence), 【his movies】 _are 30 of_ ~the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim~.

components.part: the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim
components.note: 作 of 的宾语；guilt 与 innocence、wrongdoer 与 victim 两对反义并置，正是希区柯克电影的核心张力

clauses: 本句是简单句，没有从句；主干为「主系表（be + 形容词 + of 短语）」。

phrases.meaning: 因此、所以、由此（正式用语，表推论，后常接名词或 -ing）；从此以后（…years hence …年后）
phrases.usage: 本句中作adv.，可按「主系表（be + 形容词 + of 短语）」定位它在句中的位置。
phrases.example: Hence, his movies are 30 of the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim. 所以他的片子总绕着『谁有罪、谁清白』打转，把加害人和受害人一并摆上台面。

sentences.text: He had a gift for creating stories that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal 31 with incredible plot twists in the storyline.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他有一个创造故事的天赋，那些故事由欺骗、抢劫、谋杀、腐败以及其他刑事的 31 组成，并在情节里带着难以置信的剧情反转。
analysis.translationNatural: 他天生会编故事：欺骗、抢劫、凶杀、贪腐，各类罪案一应俱全，情节还冷不丁来个惊天反转。
analysis.structMarkup: 【He】 _had a gift for creating stories_ {that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal 31} (with incredible plot twists in the storyline).

components.part: had a gift for creating stories
components.note: have a gift for doing 意为『有做某事的天赋』，for 后接动名词

components.part: that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal 31
components.note: that 修饰 stories 并在从句中作主语；consist of 后接一串并列罪名，31 须复数名词与它们同类

components.part: with incredible plot twists in the storyline
components.note: with 短语补出这些故事的卖点——反转；in the storyline 限定反转出现的位置

clauses: 定语从句「that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other crimi」：that 修饰 stories 并在从句中作主语；consist of 后接一串并列罪名，31 须复数名词与它们同类

phrases.usage: 注意区分：creating（现在分词/动名词）/ create（原形）。

phrases.usage: 注意区分：incredible（难以置信的，指事物令人惊叹）/ incredulous（表示怀疑的、不相信的，指人的态度）/ credible（可信的）/ credit（信用；学分）。
phrases.example: He had a gift for creating stories that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal 31 with incredible plot twists in the storyline. 他天生会编故事：欺骗、抢劫、凶杀、贪腐，各类罪案一应俱全，情节还冷不丁来个惊天反转。

analysis.paragraphRole: 铺开罪案清单来证明『有天赋』，31 空借 and other criminal 逼出一个复数名词。

sentences.text: The principal characters in his movies were often ordinary people 32 in unwanted and unavoidable situations.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他电影里的主角常常是普通人，32 于不想要且无法避免的处境之中。
analysis.translationNatural: 他片中的主人公多半是寻常百姓，偏偏被卷进躲不开、甩不掉的麻烦里。
analysis.structMarkup: 【The principal characters in his movies】 _were often ordinary people_ (32 in unwanted and unavoidable situations).

components.part: The principal characters in his movies
components.note: 复数主语，in his movies 作后置限定，谓语用 were

phrases.meaning: 人们（复数集合名词，谓语用复数）；民族（可数）

phrases.meaning: 情形、处境（situation 的复数）

paragraphs.text: He was 33 productive and his amazing body of work is considered fascinating by the critics. Most of his movies have 34 the test of time and are considered to be masterpieces. He is also remembered by other filmmakers, for he continues to inspire them to be passionate about their work. He is also 35 by people around the world for his entertaining and exciting stories.

sentences.text: He was 33 productive and his amazing body of work is considered fascinating by the critics.

analysis.translationLiteral: 他是 33 多产的，并且他惊人的作品总量被评论家认为是迷人的。
analysis.translationNatural: 他一辈子高产得吓人，评论界也公认这批作品耐看。

components.note: 第一分句主语，回指 Hitchcock
33 空位于 was 与形容词 productive 之间，须副词修饰，highly productive 即『极为多产』
连接两个并列分句，前说产量、后说口碑

components.part: is considered fascinating by the critics

phrases.meaning: 多产的、高效的、富有成效的、有产出的
phrases.usage: 注意区分：productive（多产的、富有成效的）/ productivity（生产率）/ produce（动词）/ productive 与 efficient（efficient 指效率高、不浪费，productive 指产出多）。

phrases.meaning: 工作；运转、奏效 / 工作、作品
phrases.usage: 注意区分：work（工作，不可数）/ job（职位，可数）/ works（工厂；作品）。常见搭配：work well / at work。

phrases.meaning: consider 的过去分词，认为、考虑
phrases.usage: 常见搭配：be considered to be。
phrases.example: He was 33 productive and his amazing body of work is considered fascinating by the critics. 他一辈子高产得吓人，评论界也公认这批作品耐看。

pitfalls: 被动语态的过去分词不能误写成过去式；不及物动词没有被动。
